summary: v48c UX/mobile-responsive pass — verified all 11 review items across desktop 1440x900, tablet 768/1023 and mobile 390x844. 9/11 fully pass; 2 minor overflow issues found on notice-detail (mobile) and vendor portal (mobile). No JS runtime errors introduced. Legacy ?ui=default renders as v47h with no data-ui attribute and no forest-green leakage.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow — documentElement.scrollWidth=457 > window=390 (67px overflow). Root cause: decorative SVG <circle> elements inside e-hero (widths 486/704/956px) and the article container computed width=433 (right edge=457) exceed viewport. h1 font-size correctly scales to 40px and KPI strip correctly drops to 2 cols. The offending elements need overflow-x:hidden on their nearest ancestor (e-hero / article wrapper) at mobile breakpoint.

Minor horizontal overflow — scrollWidth=396 vs window=390 (6px). Not visually catastrophic but strictly violates 'no horizontal page overflow'. Likely a padding/border rounding on a KPI card or the greeting band. KPI grid correctly drops to 2x2 (170px 170px).
ui_bugs.selector: unknown — needs inspection near .e-portal-kpis parent or greeting band

issues: Visible h1 has font-size 18px ('Manual Preview Vendor Pvt Ltd' — the company subheading). If review spec intended greeting-band 'Good morning, X' to be the h1 scaled to ~32px, then either the greeting is not marked as h1 or the responsive scale isn't applied. Suggest confirming semantic hierarchy or updating the .e-portal-greeting rule.

Confirm which element is intended as the h1 on vendor portal (greeting 'Good morning' vs company name). Current visible h1 renders at 18px which does not match the ~32px spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Notice-detail mobile overflow is caused by decorative SVG circles in .e-hero that are absolutely sized larger than viewport — always guard with overflow-x:hidden or clip-path on their parent when supporting mobile.
Vendor portal 6px overflow suggests a fixed-px width somewhere in .e-portal-kpis calc (170px × 2 + gap may exceed 390 - horizontal padding); consider grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)).
